regression_cases: No byte hashing during authenticated merge; final recheck always hashes
Conflicting digests and non-absolute/missing/non-file paths reject
Symlink retargeting and inventory changes reject
Same-size mutation with restored mtime rejects
Incorrect expected digest rejects at final check
Independent builds have no shared cache
